senses.gloss: m. (פְּקַע) split, esp. slits in the rectum.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 28a">Ab. Zar. 28ᵃ</cite> sq. <he>חש בפ׳</he> suffered from slits.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 28a">Ib.</cite> <he>ליתי … ולינח פ׳ להדי פ׳</he> let him get the kernel of a bramble fruit and place its split (wedge-shaped) side against the slit.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 28a">Ib.</cite> <he>פ׳ עילאה</he> slits in the upper part of the rectum, <he>פ׳ תיתאה</he> in the lower part.
